[b][u]ÜHÜMZI FOREST REMIGRATION[/u][/b]

PROCLAMATION OF THE DELARESE ACT OF UNION WITH THE ÜHÜMZI ECOREGION, THE LANDS OF ANCESTORS, BY THE GRACE OF GOD AND HIS MOST SERENE IMPERIAL HIGHNESS.

[b]At the Court of Loxodonta,[/b]
The coldest day of January, 2027.

Have it be enacted by the Yekhe and Sumun representatives of the Sublime Commonwealth of Delareaux's Khürültai, that subject to this provision of act, and upon issuance of the proclamation required section 9 (d) of this act forwarded, the Duchy of Ühümzi to be hereby declared to be a member state of the Sublime Commonwealth of Delareaux, admitted as a member on an equal footing with the other member states in all respects whatever, the constitution formed pursuant to the provisions of the "Act of Territorial Legislature of Ühümzi" entitled, [b]"An act to formally establish of a constitutional convention to prepare a constitution for the Duchy of Ühümzi: to submit the consitution for adoption or rejection; to prepare for the admission of Ühümzi as a member-state; to make an appropriate and setting and an effective date"[/b] to be forwarded before the civilian population in the Ühümzi region to vote on.

In the act of forwarding this act before the Khürültai, the Khürültai, with the approval of His Most Serene Imperial Highness, will begin the establishment of a border administration right at the doorstep of Daesun in the Ühümzi ecoregion to disallow the further expansion and expulsion of ancestral Delarese claimants who have previously lived in the ancient land held by previous legitimate Delarese head of states, to be in motion. In collaboration with Vespuria and as a member of the Corridor Treaty, have it begin planning to develop the Ühümzi ecoregion in accordance with Delarese national environmental laws and immigration amendments alike.

Concerning the immigration amendments to [b]" the Act of Union with the Ühümzi Ecoregion"[b], there shall be the invitation of Delarese, Vespurian, Dakshinese, and Montfleur civilians who would be getting government-granted plot of land and shall live under Commonwealth law. In the case of Vespurian, Dakshinese, and Montlfeur settlers, they were given mandatory Delarese cultural and language tutoring to fit in more with the native population, alongside a demand of conversion towards any denomination of Christianity. The Economic Bill of Rights concludes that settlers be given the right to work in any field of the economy within their own region, and the right to welfare provided by the Commonwealth and Duchy.

The Duchy of Ühümzi is to establish a well-drilled and well-regulated Civil Guard alongside the offices and administration in accordance with the Constitution to reaffirm its status as a member-state on an egalitarian footing with the rest. For its first ten years of foundation, it shall be provided with exclusive aid needed to bolster its further development and fit in. 

It shall be granted an equal amount of representation in both houses of the Khürültai, equal to its population size. Ühümzi shall enjoy the right of self-governance within the boundaries of the Commonwealth's constitution.

Signed,
His Most Serene Imperial Majesty: [i]Römkatar Krasznova I. [/i]

[quote=erene_federation;60935942][b]Erene Federation Emergency Resolution: January 14th, 2167.[/b]

[b]Briefing:[/b]

[i]More and more of our colonies have broken away from the Erene Federation, utterly crushing our economies which rely heavily on resources from beyond the Belt of Tears. However, these breakaways cannot produce their own food in sufficient quantities to sustain their populations. The Erene Federation fears that a war between Erene and the Spacenoid breakaways will result in heavy casualties and destruction of large sections of Erene. As such, the Federation believes that any methods need to be taken to minimise losses for Federation forces and civilians.[/i]

[b]Message from the High Council:[/b]

[i]The Erene Federation has a monopoly on food, and the colonies relied on our exports to sustain their populations. The High Council advises that all member states of the Erene Federation to cease all food trade beyond the Belt of Tears, no ship carrying food or any trade goods shall be legally permitted to travel beyond the Belt of Tears. The High Council believes this decision will force the breakaways to peacefully return into Federation control, returning to the status quo.[/i]

An immediate series of communiqués and messages to the High Council and the Erene Federation is not long after the message was sent out that Erene would cease any and all trade and transportation beyond the belt of tears, others are sent to the breakaway states and rebels and insurgents, whilst others are sent to companies and conglomerates of the solar system.

[i]|To the High Council of the Erene Federation:

The Ardagan-Zeon-Ostanes Tactical Homebase has been a leal and trusting settlement that has not once faltered, not once failed to deliver, and not once brought risk or chaos upon the Federation. An ideal colony. An ideal settlement. An ideal outpost.

We have manned the frontier, built a bastion where under we build laboratories and factories, we have built space stations, shipyards, satellites across orbit. We have done our duty, and have done it diligently. That is thusly why we ask why we are being punished.

We have done no wrong. We have hurt no soul. We have done nothing whatsoever.

And still we are punished. Unfairly. Unjustifiably. Without reason or warning or recompense. Slotted in with the rest, without trial or jury or evidence, blocked from all the necessary shipments, shipping, and shopping we do. Cut from trade, from exporting, from importing, a barrier has cursed the Belt like an iron curtain.

We implore you on behalf of a man who was raised and lived in Erene all his life for ages, and has spent decades on Zeon labouring for the sake of all civilisation to not impose such harsh treatments on us, to not punish the many for the faults of the few, if the Federation still stands for the sake of civilisation, of sapient liberty and rights.

We officially and humbly request an exclusion to if not total termination of the latest decree of the Erene Federation.

The Ardagan-Zeon-Ostanes Tactical Homebase on behalf of Autarch Aristeas Zosimos Ostanes.|
[/i]

[i]|To the SummitONE Solutions Chief Executive Officer Gale Hiram FitzDavid:

Greetings, we are the Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. We wish to speak to you regarding many topics on behalf of our Master, Mr. Ostanes, as it is His belief that the latest Federation policies, would woefully affect the connection and stability of the loyalist colonies beyond the belt into controversial and unnecessary trajectories.

We are further informed that your company handles industries and topics of matters that A.Z.O.T.H. may be interested in collaborating and internalising in. We have many projects, and field many results. We are many, tireless and sleepless, as our Master commands us, and we believe that a partnership would be most beneficial.

We are, however, unsure on the matters of LOCUS. We have heard of El Howayek Group. We have not sent them a communication as of yet, as we await their reaction to recent events, before approaching them directly, if at all. We are making up our minds regarding the matter of LOCUS based on the two pillars that dominate it.

We hope to find your reply soon, at any rate, regarding mutual cooperation on the fields of security, trade, and industry. We wish you a good day, and a time without peril.

With regards,
The Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.|
[/i]

[i]|To His Imperial Majesty, by the grace of god, Emperor of Velsparia, and of his other realms and provinces, Head of the Federation, defender of the faith, King of Feroaume, Grand Admiral of the Fleet, High Marshal of the Imperial Army, Marshall of the Imperial Aerospace Force, High General of the Imperial Territorial Army, and Commander and Chief of the Imperial Guard:

I write to you, Your Imperial Highness, on regards to recent and sudden federation matters regarding a most haste and rather telling act regarding the ingress and egress of goods and luxuries beyond the Belt of Tears, as I have kept up to date if not up in activity due my age with the homeland's activities, having trusted them in their last century and a half of stability.

Unfortunately that trust has been shaken, I am much afraid. I am an old man, who believes in order, stability and at least some freedom for the common man. And as you may know, I live rather far away, in Zeon. And these latest policies by the federation worry me that it might show that it has rather, without warning, [b]given up[/b] with anything beyond the Belt.

Now I hope to be just be wrong and assuming poorly, but the signs are telling. I've witnessed and even fought against many insurgencies, both before the federation and The Calamity, and witness a handful of these during the colonisation period, or at least attempts. I find myself shaken with all this matter of cutting trade and transportion past the Belt.

[b]At least for those loyal colonies and settlements of the Erene Federation.[/b]

And as a man who had been there for Velsparia's first settlements and eventual independence, as well as for most part of the Erene Federation's reign, I was hoping you could indulge an old man in lending your voice or at least an ear on this matters. Shipments take a while to get here and although I have stock I won't have it forever.

I've met your ancestors and I have a great interest in you, especially seeing the conflicting results and fates of the Old Kingdom into what Rosiness it has been made into. And I trust, that perhaps, you'll hopefully enlighten the High Council to more serious and pragmatic approaches than the present haste.

Yours truly,
Aristeas Zosimos Ostanes

Mysterious attacks, a food blockade, and a rising group of independent spacefaring colonies, it had been a few sleepless days for those on the Republican Committee and the triumvirate. All eyes at the point had now turned to the new consul, not even sworn into office before the masses yet, and burdened now with crises unavoidable.

The Erene Federation has decided to take a high risk maneuver in blocking food shipments to these colonies, and so, we have decided to show our teeth by announcing we will continue to make shipments regardless, began Alexander, summarising the events of the past two days to General Adams and Angthaar.

The office of the chief consul was much cleaner than it had been in the days prior, organised, and quickly assembled to provide some semblance of a base of operations, family photographs were on the shelves now, a few personal momentos scattered here and there.

Yes Consantinus, a bold move on our part but a threat to the stability of the EF no? Stated Adams.

If the colonies do as they say they will do, and attack Erene, the federation, and its member states, I think stability takes the back seat, replied Alexander.

I rather like the idea Adams, piped up Angthaar, It allows Rosenmarkke a certain ethical high ground it can stand upon, gathers us allies should the EF turn against us, loyalists, if you wish, 

Yet loyalists in revolt are not loyalists, they are just opportunitists, replied Adams.

The ball is in our court however, stated Alexander, So how do we keep a hold on it? He inclined his head to his fellow leaders.

Trade, we must establish trade, especially if we are to make mechanoid suits, stated Adams, Two days ago an attack occurred on the planet of Aceldama, it was allegedly a mechanoid, he continued.

Yes I have heard of that, patchy reports nevertheless, but you make a point, replied Alexander, What else?

I agree with Adams here, we must try soft diplomatic measures, ensure their loyalties are secured, after all, we still have the Emperor question to be settled, replied Angthaar.

Alexander sighed, the Emperor question had come up a few times, he had been briefed on it, yet he was unsure about the candidate at present, Joseph Consantinus, a little known, potentially little supported candidate among the Erenite Vespurians.

I shall write a dictat then, offering trade, replied Alexander.

[i]The Dictat of Consantinus[/i]

[b]Whereas[/b] the Erenite Federation has sought to make sure it punishes the peoples of the colonies for the actions of their governments, and whereas the EF has refused to stand down, the government of the Peoples Federal Republic of Rosenmarkke hereby declares the following:

Any state wishing to grant Rosenmarkke access to raw goods shall receive broad rations from Rosenmarkke to ensure the security of food within their state

Any state wishing to establish ties with Rosenmarkke and gain formal recognition as independent states must declare there intent in writing and send a diplomatic envoy, wherein they will be granted food rations.

All deals with Rosenmarkke shall be everlasting and sealed by the precepts and regulations of the provisions of Rosenmarkke, to be nullified only by full consent by both parties.

Their warships, built with primitive designs and armed with outdated naval guns, were no match for Daesuns modern missile-guided destroyers. The ragtag fleet was quickly overwhelmed, but Pantagruel had no intention of stopping at simply sinking ships.

Daesuns navy primarily employed inexpensive anti-ship missiles calibrated to strike the center bow of these alleged pirate vessels. This minimized casualties and preserved the ships structure for intelligence analysis. Once each vessel was disabled, a gunboat squadron was dispatched to recover survivors. They were then transported to Daesun and held for trial.

Daesun was not interested in killing these men. Instead, every prisoner underwent an extensive background investigation involving birthplace, origin, education, and other key details. Each factor helped trace where these individuals came from. A pattern slowly emerged as Daesunite intelligence continued to dig forward. Nearly all the conspirators shared a common origin in Nederlandse.

Further abnormalities appeared in the ships manifests, including equipment accessible only to the Dutch military, irregular fuel and cargo records, operations occurring dangerously close to or even inside the BalionDaesun warzone, and docking logs in Hyunseo followed by immediate departures toward Daesunite coastal towns.

With sufficient evidence and a clear justification, Daesun formally accuses the Dutch state of sponsoring terrorist activity by aiding mercenaries in unlawful attacks on Daesunite civilians and merchant vessels, filing the case with the ICJ.

The Dutch States attempt to indirectly attack Daesun was now recognized as a direct attack, and therefore a formal violation of the nations sovereignty meaning that Daesun now had the ability to invoke existing mutual defence pacts with other nations. The states of Oceanice Republic, Neue Republik, Immeria, Hayan Dal, Hyunseo, Luscaria, Avalon, and Valddera are all required under their active mutual defence pacts to aid Daesun. Preparations for an international coalition for the invasion of the Dutch State are underway once permitted by the ICJ.

The Frame 167 came apart, piece by piece, each successful shell striking like a microburst of a silent firework that spew shards and shrapnel like a terrible hail in a gigantic radius around the mobile suit. Inside, NSI3-5 began to feel the effects of the constant ballistics, her body steadily getting whittled down by the violent vibration, the spalling, and yet, like a blood-seeking beast, the clone persisted, her body held together by the pressure of her power armor and repeated doses of painkillers to keep her cognizant even in the heat of the battle.

[list]"Hehe... " the clone chuckled, taking off her gas mask which had by now been exhausted of its psychoactive drug matrix. The air inside the cockpit of the mobile suit was now searing hot, the heat from the nuclear reactor slowly emanating through the open cracks where once stood airlocks that kept the suit's temperature in check. "That's it, just like that!"[/list]

Having expended all of its ammunition, Frame 167 switched to its last resort, a large steel saber some 8.5 meters in length and 50 centimeters in width, and attempted to charge the Illynite horde of tanks, Artillerists, Wardens, and PT boats, seemingly intent on a suicidal charge. However, this was just a ruse. Before another shell could risk landing a perfect hit on the Frame 167's cockpit and incapacitating her, NSI3-5 inputted a final command into the mobile suit's internal computer and instigating an irreversible process.

[list]"This is NSI3-5 signing off!" she said triumphantly, just as she turns into nothing, every single fuel propellant in the Frame 167 suddenly bursting open into a gigantic explosion, a fireball rising up where the mobile was before dissipating into nothing.[/list]

Just like in the Whitney massacre, the mobile suit would be reduced to an unrecognizable wreck, parts flying in all directions. The cockpit with the embedded clone would be a total loss, as would be most of the armaments save for the saber which would be flung outwards perhaps into yet another unlucky dome or armored fighting vehicle. While much of the model numbers and identifiers of what remained of the Frame 167, a small, black-colored carbon steel plate would figure prominently among the rubble, embedded upon which was an icon vaguely resembling a four-pointed star.
